description:
Connect ChatGPT to your Runrun.it workspace to manage work without leaving the conversation. This app lets you quickly create one or multiple tasks and search existing tasks, using your actual Runrun.it data and permissions.

It also helps you add the right context by letting you browse boards, stages, task types, projects, and tags before creating tasks—so what you create is already organized the way your team works. Great for turning ideas into tasks, and finding the status of work fast.
